BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to online nursing programs; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there is acontinuing, critical shortage of nurses in Washington and that thestate must increase its efforts to educate nurses to meet the futuredemands in the state. The legislature further finds that eLearningprograms, such as the successful eLearning nursing program at LowerColumbia College, merit special recognition for enhancing theopportunities of students from all regions of Washington to access highquality nursing preparation coursework. The legislature further findsthat the eLearning program in nursing at Lower Columbia College shouldbe shared, replicated, and expanded to the greatest extent possible.The legislature recognizes that a major obstacle to expansion ofnursing programs is the cost of developing and the availability ofclinical sites. The legislature further recognizes the need to developadditional pathways for the development of clinical nursing sites for p. 1 SB 6703eLearning students on a statewide basis.
